verdict.rationale: Sill documents its own Homebrew tap (`brew install --cask saffsanity/sill/sill`), a scriptable, non-interactive way to install and upgrade the Mac client that an admin could run across machines. Nothing in the evidence covers MDM deployment, a .pkg/managed installer, or preset/managed configuration, and Sill pairs per device with no account system. Missing for 10: MDM/managed-package distribution, preset or managed configuration (e.g. configuration profiles or defaults), fleet-oriented silent-install documentation, and deployment of the iPhone/iPad client.
